chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family (SAWW), said:
"Gray hair at the front of the head is a sign of blessing, at the temples is a sign of generosity, at the hair ends is a sign of courage, and at the nape is a sign of ill-omen."

key_terms.ٱلذَّوَائِبِ: the hair locks or hanging ends of the hair
key_terms.ٱلْعَارِضَيْنِ: the two sides of the forehead or temples
key_terms.ٱلْقَفَا: the nape or back of the neck

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the meaning of gray hair appearing in different parts of the head?
ai.summary: This hadith from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله associates the location of gray hair with particular qualities or omens. It reflects a transmitted prophetic saying concerning signs and characteristics linked to bodily appearance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.335 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Gray hair at the front of the head is a sign of blessing, at the temples is a sign of generosity, at the hair ends is a sign of courage, and at the nape of the neck is a sign of ill-omen."
